description: Election Commission - Declare that H. P. N. S. Thilakarathana was selected as the member of the Kegalle P/S
categorisation: This gazette notice concerns the filling of a vacancy in a local government body (Kegalle Pradeshiya Sabha) due to the death of a member, as per the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It details the process of nominating a new member by a recognized political party and the official declaration by the Returning Officer. This content falls squarely under electoral processes and the administration of local government elections.
